report_text: Worker performed maintenance without isolating electrical energy.
Worker repaired equipment without isolating energy source.
Technician bypassed lockout tagout procedure during panel repair.
Electrician worked on live circuit without de-energizing the panel.
Maintenance crew removed guard on rotating machine while still energized.
Worker entered a vessel without proper gas testing.
Worker entered a confined space without atmospheric testing.
Employee entered a storage tank without a permit or gas test.
Worker entered manhole without ventilation or gas monitoring.
Crew member entered silo without confined space entry permit.
Welding was performed without a proper hot work permit.
Hot work carried out near flammable material without a permit.
Cutting operation performed without fire watch or hot work permit.
Grinding sparks ignited nearby combustible material during unpermitted hot work.
Worker was standing below a suspended load.
Employee walked under a raised forklift load.
Worker positioned himself in the line of fire of a swinging crane load.
Personnel stood in drop zone while load was being lifted.
Worker worked at height without fall protection harness.
Employee worked on scaffold without guardrails at height.
Worker climbed ladder above six feet without fall arrest system.
Technician worked near open edge on rooftop without harness.
Crane lifted load exceeding rated capacity during lifting operation.
Lifting operation performed with damaged sling and no inspection.
Rigger used unrated chain for a critical lift.
Improper rigging caused load to shift during a lifting operation.
Pressure vessel was opened while still pressurized.
Worker exposed to hazardous chemical without isolating the line.
Worker climbed to change a bulb on a ladder over four meters without harness.
Fitter opened flange on live line without isolation and drained system.
Worker slipped while walking in the office but was not seriously injured.
Employee tripped over a cable in the corridor.
Minor paper cut while handling documents at the desk.
Worker spilled coffee on the office floor.
Staff member bumped into a cabinet while walking.
Employee reported mild eye strain from computer screen.
Worker misplaced a tool in the store room.
Housekeeping noted a small water spill near the water cooler which was cleaned promptly.
Employee forgot to log out of the shared computer.
Minor dust noted on the office window sill.
Worker wore incorrect color lanyard for visitor badge.
Staff left desk lamp on overnight with no hazard identified.
Employee reported slightly noisy air conditioner in the break room.
Cafeteria chair was found wobbly and reported for repair.
Small paint smudge found on the meeting room wall.
Worker forgot to submit weekly timesheet on time.
Office printer ran out of paper during a print job.
Worker misplaced safety manual on the shelf.
Parking sign faded and needs repainting with no near miss.
Employee suggested improving lighting in the parking lot.
